component.name: GL Editor
component.summary: GPU-rendered text editor with three graphics backends

description.p: GL Editor is an experimental text editor that draws its text on the GPU. Documents are laid out as pages in a 3D scene, shaped and rasterised with Pango and Cairo, and drawn as instanced quads sampled from a glyph atlas.

One rendering pipeline serves three graphics APIs. Everything above the backend is written against a single device interface and names no graphics API, so the same frame can be produced through OpenGL 3.3, OpenGL ES 3.0 or Vulkan 1.0, chosen at run time.

The renderer draws only what is on screen: pages outside the view are culled, and pages too far away for their glyphs to be legible are drawn as one solid bar per line, at the darkness the text itself would have. The glyph atlas is mipmapped so minified text does not crawl when the camera moves, and grows on demand rather than being sized for the worst case.
